name: Monica Martinez
bottom_line: Her biography and the budget figures she cites check out. Most of the record is statewide budget items, presented without saying they were budget-wide, and a couple of bill claims stop short of their current status.
findings: Child-credit, school-meal, Foundation Aid and Environmental Protection Fund figures match the FY2026 enacted budget. These were statewide budget items; her role was her vote.
The $8 billion unemployment-insurance debt figure couldn't be matched; the Fiscal Policy Institute put the federal UI debt at about $6.2 billion.
S7335 (Enhanced STAR for seniors) did pass the Senate in June 2025, but died in the Assembly and is back in committee in 2026.
page_issues: "Tire 1 and 2" typo in the pension section.
Endorsements are shown only as logos.
